name: sdlc
description: AI-native SDLC: lanes from intent to merge, a review loop capped at three rounds, and hooks that enforce each project's own checks.

interface.shortDescription: AI-native SDLC: lanes, a capped review loop, enforced project checks
interface.longDescription: Runs the AI-Native SDLC Playbook in any repo: pick a lane, write intent/spec/plan when it pays, lint every edit, verify before finishing, and review in at most three rounds.
